description: Is it safe to pay this address? /check without the token score: OFAC SDN screen, who it is (exchange, issuer or verified contract name; mixers and fake claim contracts flagged), wallet age, first funder and large transfers on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon (activity on Solana), with the funder and counterparties screened too. Returns ok, caution or block with plain reasons. No chain given: it finds the busiest one. Not legal advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Address you are about to pay or receive from

chain.description: Chain of the payment. Omit it and a base58 address is checked on solana; a 0x address on the EVM chain where it (or the token) has the most transactions, reported in chainDetection

expect.description: What the address should be: eoa (a wallet), contract, or any (default); a mismatch gives caution

name: prepayment_safety_check_lite
